h: NCDC says Nigeria has one confirmed Ebola case as contact tracing continues
p: The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control says one confirmed Ebola case remains in the country, alongside two suspected cases. Dozens of contacts of the patient, who reportedly travelled from Uganda, have been identified and are being monitored. Authorities urge the public to rely on official updates.
more: A toll-free line, 6232, is open for reporting suspected cases.
Several states, including Zamfara, have stepped up airport and motor-park screening.
Contacts under monitoring are due weekly allowances, the agency has said.
